intervention: Minced rather than intact beef in the tested older-adult meal

moa.summary: Physical disruption of the food matrix
moa.description: Mincing physically disrupts the beef matrix and may facilitate digestive release; the study does not isolate mediation.
moa.evidenceQualification: Physicochemical interpretation; causal mediation of the measured response was not isolated.

semanticReview.rationale: Uses the existing pilot process label; the physical process is distinguished from unproven mediation of the measured response. Digestibility and plasma endpoints are not interchangeable.

biologicalRelationship.measuredEffect: The tested texture change increased six-hour appearance of dietary phenylalanine in ten older men.
biologicalRelationship.pmRelevance: Circulating amino-acid provision within PM1; not brain transport or neurotransmitter efficacy.

limitations.text: Ten older men; one 135 g beef protocol.
Dietary phenylalanine appearance is not brain delivery.
No detectable total plasma EAA or muscle-protein-synthesis difference.

intervention: Boiled rather than raw eggs in the tested postexercise meal

moa.description: Heating alters egg protein structure and digestive accessibility; separate digestibility evidence does not isolate mediation of the postexercise plasma response.
moa.evidenceQualification: Physicochemical interpretation; causal mediation of the measured response was not isolated.

semanticReview.rationale: Uses the existing pilot process label; the physical process is distinguished from unproven mediation of the measured response. Digestibility and plasma endpoints are not interchangeable.

biologicalRelationship.measuredEffect: Boiled eggs produced higher peak circulating essential-amino-acid concentrations than raw eggs in the tested postexercise meal, supporting PM1’s circulating precursor-provision function.
biologicalRelationship.pmRelevance: Circulating amino-acid provision within PM1; not brain transport or neurotransmitter efficacy.

limitations.text: 45 trained young men; five eggs after exercise.
Plasma concentration is not dietary tracer appearance or brain delivery.
Ileal digestibility measured in a separate five-patient ileostomy study.
No detectable muscle-protein-synthesis advantage; not evidence of equivalence.
